reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Samsung Account again
reauth_confirm.description:
The SmartThings Find session could not be renewed automatically. This usually means the Samsung Account sign-in was revoked, the password changed, or the account was signed out.

Select **Submit** to sign in again.

auth_code.title: Sign in to your Samsung Account
auth_code.description:
1. Open [this sign-in link]({login_url}) and log in to your Samsung Account.
2. The browser will then try to open an `ms-app://...` address and show an error, or ask to open an external app. That is expected — cancel any app prompt and leave the tab open.
3. Open your browser's developer tools (F12), go to **Network** or **Console**, and copy the full address starting with `ms-app://`.
4. Paste it below.

Copy the `ms-app://` address itself, not the address of the visible error page.
